title: Region
description: One region (a country, province, kingdom…) drawn on a map: a GeoJSON Feature (RFC 7946) stored as content/regions/<id>.json. COORDINATES ARE [lon, lat] IN THE MAP IMAGE'S OWN FRAME: lon = x / width * 360 - 180 and lat = 90 - y / height * 180, where x/y are pixels in the image as uploaded. They are NOT adjusted for the slot's prime meridian shift or pole padding; the globe applies the same padding and shift to the region as to the texture, so the region stays on the land when those settings change. That's why the numbers can differ from the globe's grid labels on a padded or shifted globe. Longitudes are within [-180, 180] and every edge takes the shorter way round (so [179, 0] → [-179, 0] crosses the antimeridian and is 2° long). A ring may span at most 180° of longitude and may not contain a pole. Rings are closed, have at least 4 positions, outer rings are counter-clockwise and holes clockwise, and they don't cross themselves. At most 70000 vertices in total. The id is permanent (embeds point at it): each part's label is in properties.partLabels. Parts (the polygons of a MultiPolygon) are layers, drawn in order: where parts overlap, a later part covers an earlier one.

id.description: Permanent id; must match the file name. Embeds use it: v/<slot>/?region=<id>.

name.description: Optional legacy display name (plain text). The admin editor no longer sets it; part labels (partLabels) replace it.

slot.description: Slot (in content/slots.json) whose globe shows this region.

map.description: Map id the region was drawn on.

color.description: Fill and border colour, #rgb or #rrggbb: the colour of parts whose partLegend entry is -1 (the editor's "Default colour").

colorLabel.description: Legend label for `color` (plain text). The embed's legend lists the region's own colour first, once it has a label. Leave it out for none.

label.description: Show the part labels (or, for a region without partLabels, its name) in the embed.

legendTitle.description: Heading of the embed's legend (plain text). Defaults to "Legend".

legend.description: Extra colours for the region's parts, each with a plain-text label. The embed lists every colour with a non-empty label as a legend (key=0 hides it).

partLegend.description: One entry per polygon of the geometry (a Polygon is one part), in order: the index of the legend entry whose colour that part is drawn in, or -1 for the region's own colour. Leave it out to draw every part in the region's colour.

partLabels.description: One entry per polygon of the geometry, in order: the label the embed shows on that part (plain text), or "" for none. Must have one entry per part when present.

partContested.description: LEGACY, no longer written. One entry per polygon: -1, or k to mark the part as a "contested zone" of part k. Contested zones were replaced by layers: parts are drawn in order, and where parts overlap the later part covers the earlier one. When a region with this field loads, a zone whose partLegend entry is -1 takes part k's colour; nothing else changes, and the editor drops the field at the next save.

partLocked.description: One entry per polygon of the geometry, in order: true for a part locked in the admin editor, so it can't be dragged or nudged as a whole (its vertices and midpoints still edit). Editor-only; the embed ignores it. Leave it out when no part is locked.

nationalBorders.description: Draw national borders: where two parts of the region share a line exactly (drawn with snapping or tracing), the embed draws a thick dark line on a light casing between parts of different legend colours, and leaves the line off between parts of the same colour. Off unless true: parts that touch just touch. Leave it out for off.

provinceBorders.description: Province borders drawn inside the region with the editor's Province border tool: open lines of [lon, lat] positions (at least 2 each, in the map image's frame like the geometry; each step takes the shorter way round). The embed draws them as fine dotted dark lines, only where they lie inside the region's (non-contested) parts. They don't change the parts. At most 5000 positions in all. Leave it out when there are none.

created.description: When the region was first saved.

createdBy.description: Who created the region: they (and anyone allowed to edit others' regions) can change it. Set by the admin page and checked by the admin API. Missing on regions from before owners existed, which belong to the repository owner.

id.description: GitHub account id (permanent, survives a rename).
